title: This Bird Flew 7,500 Miles in 11 Days Without Landing

scenes.text: One bird flew 7,500 miles without landing once.
It's a bar-tailed godwit, and it took off from Alaska and landed in New Zealand.
The flight took 11 days, and it flew over open ocean the entire way.
Before the trip, it shrinks its own organs to travel light.
Its speed hit 55 miles an hour.
A satellite tag tracked every mile of it.
The longest nonstop flight of any bird.

description:
A bar-tailed godwit flew about 7,500 miles from Alaska to New Zealand in 11 days without landing.
It shrinks its own organs to travel light.
Would you survive 11 days without stopping?
first_comment: Could you stay awake for 11 days? Neither could we.
